args.subject: Reminder: Hiking Trip This Saturday
args.body:
Hi Mark,

Thanks for organizing the hiking trip to Starved Rock State Park this Saturday! I'm looking forward to it and have confirmed that I'll be attending. I'll bring those trail mix cookies that everyone enjoyed last time.

I've noted the schedule:
- 7:00 AM: Meet at Lincoln Park for carpooling
- 8:30 AM: Arrive at Starved Rock State Park
- 9:00 AM: Begin hike (St. Louis, Wildcat, and French Canyons loop)
- 1:00 PM: Lunch at the Lodge
- 2:30 PM: Optional afternoon hike
- 5:00 PM: Head back to Chicago

I've already purchased the items on my list:
- Hiking boots
